thread:
maya: Hey infra team — onboarding a new customer account (garden-proxy) and we need a one-time accelerator ceiling increase in eu-west-5. Planning to run MLP training-ish inference jobs and steady-serving. Can we lift p5 -> 8, p4d -> 4, g5 -> 12 across the org account? Need ENI and VPC quota bumps too.
conor: What is the target launch date and the account ID? Also need AZ preference (we prefer eu-west-5a/c), and whether they require placement groups.
maya: Targeting week of 2026-05-11. Account ID 987654321000. Prefer a/c. No special placement group needed for now, but would like ENI per-subnet bump to 200 and EC2 instance limit for GPU family increased to support the requested counts.
ali: Quick cost/ops sanity check — is this for Dedicated pools or test/dev in Hosted? If Dedicated, we should talk reserved capacity vs just quota bump.
maya: This will start as Dedicated reserved pool for predictable latency. We'll commit to a 3-month pilot. Budgeted.
conor: OK — I'll open an AWS quota case. Suggest we ask for the following explicit quota names to avoid ambiguity: "Running On-Demand P5 Instances", "Running On-Demand P4d Instances", "Running On-Demand G5 Instances" and "Elastic Network Interfaces per Subnet". Provide per-AZ numbers and total.
maya: Copying the exact ask here (for_support_case):
```
Region: eu-west-5
Account: 987654321000
AZs: eu-west-5a, eu-west-5c
Request:
  - Running On-Demand P5 Instances: increase to 8
  - Running On-Demand P4d Instances: increase to 4
  - Running On-Demand G5 Instances: increase to 12
  - Elastic Network Interfaces per Subnet: increase to 200
Reason: Dedicated inference fleet (pilot) for a paying customer. Required for predictable throughput and isolation. Launch week of 2026-05-11. Contact: maya@redwood.ai
```
conor: Great. I'll include projected sustained instance hours and the committed spend for the pilot — AWS asks for utilization justification. Maya can you paste the expected avg vCPU-hours / month or monthly spend?
maya: We're estimating ~10k GPU hours/month across the pooled fleet (mostly p5), expected monthly spend ~ $220k (on-demand equivalent before committed discounts). Adding a note about traffic patterns: 9am-5pm heavy, nights light.
jess: From SRE perspective: watch ENI placement/ subnet IP exhaustion. If we're adding 12 g5 + 8 p5, each GPU instance might use 1-2 ENIs depending on ENI-per-instance overlay. We should also request a VPC Elastic IP quota if NAT gateways will scale.
ali: Also consider soft strategy: ask AWS for a phased increase (v1: allow smaller g5 counts, v2: full). They sometimes expedite phased requests faster.
conor: I'll file the case with the full numbers and offer phased if AWS pushes back. Drafting the support form now. Will attach the pilot contract for spend justification.
infra-bot: [quota-request] created ticket Q-2026-0427-IX (internal tracking) referencing AWS case 1234567890.
maya: Thanks — please cc the customer success lead (emily) on the AWS case so they see progress.
conor: Done. AWS case created: case 1234567890. ETA from AWS initial response: ~48 hours.
jess: FYI — if AWS flags instance family placement constraints, we can propose cross-region fallback to eu-west-3 for non-latency-critical workloads. Keep the routing policy flexible.
ali: One more ops ask: add a note to the case that we may request ENI quota per-ENI limit increase for the secondary subnets in the same VPC (subnet-05a111, subnet-05a222). Helps them pre-approve network scale.
maya: Added subnet IDs to the support case.
conor: I'll post updates here once I get the AWS reply. If they require technical justification, be ready to include our infra architecture diagram and expected burst patterns.
maya: Thx all :thumbsup:
conor: AWS responded — initial review says they need committed spend confirmation and that p5/similar accelerator increases under new region onboarding take longer. They've asked for the pilot contract and examples of production traffic. I'll escalate to an account manager.
jess: Keep an eye on cost center tagging to ensure charges map to the reserved pool. Also log the quota case ID in the onboarding ticket.
infra-bot: [update] AWS case 1234567890 status: "Case received". Internal tracker Q-2026-0427-IX updated.
maya: Uploading the pilot contract and a brief traffic sample to the AWS case now.
conor: AWS asked whether we can accept a phased approval: p4d/g5 first, p5 later. They can approve p4d/g5 within 72h if we accept phased. Thoughts?
maya: Fine with phased as long as p5 approval completes before pilot end (3 months).
ali: I'll sketch a temporary routing/fallback plan to avoid blocking the pilot if p5 is delayed.
conor: Noted. Closing loop: I'll add timelines and follow up in 24h.
maya: Appreciate it everyone.
